cards.title: Children's Cabin
cards.rules: Get absolutely stoned, or drink 1 whenever anyone draws until your next turn.

cards.title: Like I Said
cards.rules: Drink 2. Until your next turn, mimic the next player.

cards.title: Steve's Spyder Beanie
cards.rules: Until your next turn, send every drink given to you back to the sender.

cards.title: Deez Nuts
cards.rules: You are Deez for the rest of the game. Anyone who falls for your deez nuts joke drinks 3.

cards.title: Ohio
cards.rules: That sucks. Drink 2, and until your next turn answer everything with "It's not that bad."

cards.title: Part of the Crew
cards.rules: Pick up to 3 crew. Until your next turn, when one of you drinks, all of you drink.

cards.title: Dream Team
cards.rules: Until your next turn, you may split your drinks with anyone beside you.

cards.title: President
cards.rules: Until your next turn, give anyone orders. Anyone who refuses drinks 2.

cards.title: 3rd World Christmas
cards.rules: Give someone an imaginary gift and describe it. They act thrilled, or drink 3.

cards.title: Maddy Booty
cards.rules: Roll 1d20. You drink until the group counts to it, or you finish your drink.

dice.instruction: Drink until the group counts to {total}, or finish your drink.

cards.title: Ursaring
cards.rules: Give 13 and apologize

cards.title: Wench
cards.rules: You are the drink wench until your next turn

cards.title: No take, Give
cards.rules: Give d6 drinks

cards.title: Pokemon
cards.rules: Speak only your first name until your next turn

cards.title: Pet that dog
cards.rules: Better pet any dog in the room, or take 1d6

cards.title: Abra like a Slut
cards.rules: Reverse the turn order for the rest of the game

cards.title: Whinnie the Pooh
cards.rules: Pooh-bear 1d6 drinks
